Fix: Pin Go version for regctl mod commands

Without pinning, the Go version can differ in regctl installs from main based on what is provided in the default GHA builder.
Go version 1.27 changed compression levels in a way that breaks reproducibility.[0]
This should fix reproducibility issues if the same version of Go is used to build regctl.
The RELEASE_GO_VER environment variable is used to manage the value with version-bump identically with other actions.

[0]: https://go-review.googlesource.com/c/go/+/707355

Signed-off-by: Brandon Mitchell <git@bmitch.net>

Fix: Improve reproducibility with tags on main branch

Go includes the last tag in the history in the embedded VCS data.
This means a shallow git clone will generate a different binary from a deep clone.
To fix this, the GitHub actions now perform a deep clone for released artifacts.
The Makefile also needed a minor fix to how tags are detected.
